Ben — thanks for the recap and the demo today. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Procurement threshold: our central procurement team flags anything > $25k/month for multi-month commitments; PO routing and legal review can add 4–6 weeks. For month-to-month smaller spends under $25k we can do quicker ad-hoc approvals.
2) Token estimate: 55M looks reasonable as a baseline. We do expect bursts (billing footprint) on major campaign days — recommend modeling a 2x peak to be safe (so 110M in peak months).
3) Target unit price: $12 / 1M tokens is aspirational; procurement would like anchor pricing in the $8–11 / 1M range given the committed volume.

If you can show a structure that keeps expected monthly spend under $25k (or a committed discount that materially reduces $/1M) we'll be in a much faster lane. Happy to have procurement join a short call if needed.

—Aisha
